scripts.verify:chrome: PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$PWD/node_modules/.cache/puppeteer node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p=require('puppeteer');const executable=p.executablePath();console.log('Chrome executable:',executable);if(!fs.existsSync(executable)){console.error('Chrome installation is missing.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.postinstall: npm run install:chrome && npm run verify:chrome
